basis: Trace the actual stopped native delivery, reproduce host and dispatch failures using synthetic fixtures, repair system routing without altering products or weakening release conditions.

roots.evidence: Native state remained inspect/stopped. Finding f6 explicitly identified Balance's forbidden inputs table but labelled it follow-up. Host sent only semantic blockers into revise.
roots.cause: Known deterministic failures were release blockers, but their correction scheduling depended on the model's semantic severity judgment.
roots.change: Inspect now schedules the existing single revise for actual handoff/reference diagnostics too. Exact source documents determine write scope; recorded findings remain unchanged. Unmapped diagnostics and unavailable owner decisions stop rather than expanding scope.

roots.classification: dispatch implementation defect, independently reproduced during repair
roots.evidence: Synthetic missing calculation citation reached revise, then designCalculationFiles realpathSync threw ENOENT before the native submit was called.
roots.cause: Collecting existing authorized evidence paths treated a missing citation as a fatal dispatch exception, preventing correction of the document that cited it.
roots.change: Skip only ENOENT while collecting existing calculation write targets. Missing references still fail the release check. No grant to create missing calculation evidence; symlink and containment checks remain.

roots.evidence: Scene requests 103,104,111,112 falsely denied legitimate checker invocations in semicolon/loop commands. Prefix regex recognized only start-of-command or &&.
roots.cause: A Bash pathname substring was treated as proof of reading implementation source.
roots.change: Remove the ambiguous Bash checker-source inference; preserve direct-file source/log guards, child-dispatch restrictions and the native permission decision.
roots.limitation: BGS no longer separately rejects arbitrary shell reads of checker source by this heuristic. Native shell permissions adjudicate them; this author guard is not a general shell sandbox.
